meta.title: Frequently Asked Questions , Modest.Shops
meta.description: Answers to the most common questions about products, orders, delivery, and returns at Modest.Shops.

faq.seoDescription: Find answers to the most common questions about Modest.Shops, products, orders, delivery, returns, and more.
faq.heroLead: Find quick answers to the most common questions about products, orders, delivery, and our services.

items.question: What is Modest.Shops?
items.answer: Modest.Shops is a brand from the Republic of Moldova specialising in original, niche, and oriental fragrances, carefully selected for those seeking distinctive and authentic scents.

items.question: Where is Modest.Shops located?
items.answer: Modest.Shops operates from Chișinău, Republic of Moldova, with delivery across the country.

items.question: Are the products genuine?
items.answer: Yes. All products sold by Modest.Shops are 100% genuine. We work exclusively with authentic fragrances sourced from trusted suppliers.

items.question: What types of fragrances can I find?
items.answerIntro: In the Modest.Shops range you will find:
answerItems: internationally recognised brands in the fragrance world

items.question: Are the fragrances sealed?
items.answer: Yes. All fragrances are delivered sealed in the manufacturer's original packaging, unless clearly stated otherwise (e.g. decant).

items.question: Do you offer fragrances on order?
items.answer: Yes. If a product is out of stock, it can be specially ordered with an estimated delivery time of 7–10 working days.

items.question: How can I place an order?
answerItems: via message (Instagram / phone), depending on available options
items.answerOutro: After placing an order, you will be contacted for confirmation.

items.question: Can I cancel an order?
items.answer: Yes, an order can be cancelled before dispatch. To cancel, please contact us as quickly as possible.

items.question: What payment methods are available?
answerItems: online payment (if available on the site)
items.answerOutro: The exact method will be shown during the order process.

items.question: Where do you deliver?
items.answer: We deliver across the entire territory of the Republic of Moldova.

items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answerOutro: The time frame may vary depending on the courier and location.

items.question: What is the delivery cost?
items.answer: The delivery cost is shown at checkout and may vary depending on the destination.

items.question: Can I return a product?
items.answer: Yes, under Moldovan law, products may be returned within 14 calendar days, provided they are sealed and unused.

items.question: Why can I not return an unsealed fragrance?
items.answer: For hygiene and safety reasons, unsealed or used fragrances cannot be returned.

items.question: What do I do if I receive the wrong or a defective product?
items.answer: Please contact us within 48 hours of receiving the parcel and our team will resolve the situation as quickly as possible.

items.question: Can fragrances cause allergies?
items.answer: Like any cosmetic product, fragrances may cause allergic reactions. We recommend checking the ingredients and testing the product carefully.
items.answerNote: Modest.Shops is not responsible for individual allergic reactions.

items.question: Do I need to create an account to order?
items.answer: Not necessarily. You can place orders without an account, depending on the options available on the site.

items.question: How is my data protected?
items.answer: Your data is protected in accordance with Law No. 133/2011 on the protection of personal data in the Republic of Moldova.

items.question: How can I get in touch with Modest.Shops?
Do you offer advice on choosing a fragrance?
items.answer: Yes. We are happy to help with personalised recommendations based on your preferences.

faq.moreQuestionsBody: If you have further questions, do not hesitate to contact us , we are here to help.
faq.additionalInfoLead: Visit our other pages for more details
